notes: MAD-214 first-ever turbo4-FP8 PPL on real model. Path: paged AITER + FP8 WMMA (MAD_USE_AITER=1, --kv-tiered 100,0,0). Centroid LUT: embedded canonical Qwen3.5-4B fallback (Phase 1G-E auto-calibration on this model not yet wired). Even with the WRONG LUT, PPL lands between f16 (5.7507) and turbo4 (5.7888) — recipe is robust. Speed: 184s vs stock turbo4 218s (15% faster) because fused scatter inside AITER kernel avoids the per-tile sync the stock FATTN_VEC + set_rows_turbo4 path eats.

cells.notes: First-fit E4M3 snap collapses 6/16 centroids onto 0x00. SLIGHTLY WORSE than fallback (5.7796) on this model — fitter quality is the bottleneck without Hadamard.

Distinct-snap fixes the collapse (8 unique near-zero bytes), marginally better than first-fit (5.8022 → 5.7984) but still worse than fallback (5.7796). Root cause: without Hadamard rotation, K_cur is heavily peaked near zero, so MSE-optimal centroid placement misallocates encoding capacity away from the attention-relevant magnitude tail. Hadamard wiring at scatter time is needed to fix this — see MAD-224 acceptance criteria.
